title: A clear path from the compass is recorded, not escalated; decisions need an active review process (2026-11-03)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content:
I need to be able to get the compass used properly to manage decisions.
When a decision has a very clear path from the compass, it should rarely need to be escalated. if its significant, we can just record the rationale.

A general missing piece is an active decision review process. the muSrs research shows that Stating the conditions for review is a key to long term accountabilty in human decision making. It probably matters here too.

sections.name: source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-03 afternoon, continuing the flow review (vignette 8d4deae4).
